Credential.heading: Certified to build the Kingdom's future
Credential.subheading: Independently audited standards and accreditations that govern how we plan, build, operate and maintain — across every project in the Kingdom.

environment.title: ISO 14001:2015 — Environmental Management System (EMS)
environment.subtitle: TMYAZNA's commitment to sustainability
environment.description: This certification reflects TMYAZNA's proactive dedication to minimizing environmental impact, preventing pollution, and promoting sustainable industrial practices. By integrating these global environmental benchmarks into our core operations, we ensure that our infrastructure development and engineering projects are executed with a minimal carbon footprint. This framework directly reinforces our environmental portfolios — including Reverse Osmosis plant integration, greywater recycling, and smart sensor-based waste tracking — ensuring our operations seamlessly align with the eco-friendly mandates of the Saudi Green Initiative and Saudi Vision 2030.
environment.imageAlt: Electrical systems being inspected by a technician

quality.title: ISO 9001:2015 — Quality Management System (QMS)
quality.subtitle: TMYAZNA's Commitment to Excellence
quality.description: This certification validates that TMYAZNA operates a rigorous corporate framework dedicated to continuous improvement, operational efficiency, and uncompromising service quality. By embedding these global standard processes into our daily operations, we guarantee that all complex HVAC, Fire Life Safety, Electrical, and Mechanical installations are executed with absolute technical precision. This framework serves as a vital foundation for satisfying the strict vendor pre-qualification criteria required by Saudi Arabia's landmark giga-projects, while ensuring our procurement, engineering, and project management teams consistently exceed client expectations and fully comply with the Saudi Building Code (SBC).

facility.title: TMYAZNA's Commitment to Lifecycle Optimization
facility.subtitle: TMYAZNA's Commitment to Lifecycle Optimization
facility.description: This certification recognizes TMYAZNA's capability to deliver integrated facility management solutions that meet the highest international benchmarks for safety, efficiency, and comfort. By embedding these specialized standards into our operations, we go beyond basic maintenance to provide proactive, technology-driven Hard and Soft FM services. This framework empowers our on-site technical teams to utilize CAFM and digital tools to reduce downtime, minimize operational costs, and guarantee maximum uptime for critical assets, ensuring a pristine and high-performance environment across the Kingdom's high-traffic commercial and industrial giga-projects.

occupational.title: ISO 45001:2018 — Occupational Health & Safety Management System (OH&SMS)
occupational.subtitle: TMYAZNA's Commitment to Workforce Protection
occupational.description: This certification validates TMYAZNA's proactive implementation of an advanced framework designed to eliminate workplace hazards, reduce risks, and protect the health and welfare of our people. By enforcing these strict occupational safety protocols across all operations, we guarantee a secure, incident-free environment for our certified teams. This rigorous safety system is vital for executing high-risk activities — such as high-voltage distribution, heavy mechanical installations, and complex civil construction — ensuring full compliance with local civil defense codes and satisfying the stringent safety criteria of international developers like NEOM and Red Sea Global.

membership.title: BICSc Corporate Membership — The British Institute of Cleaning Science
membership.subtitle: TMYAZNA's Commitment to Elite Hygiene Standards
membership.description: This globally recognized membership confirms that TMYAZNA adheres to premium, scientifically backed hygienic standards and sustainable cleaning protocols. By integrating these specialized British standards into our operations, this membership validates our capability to handle sensitive technical environments, medical waste protocols, and luxury finishes using eco-friendly technologies — ensuring a completely sanitized, professional environment that enhances occupant well-being and protects your structural investment.
membership.imageAlt: TMYAZNA's Commitment to Elite Hygiene Standards

ministry.title: Ministry of Municipalities and Housing — Contractor Classification Certificate
ministry.subtitle: TMYAZNA's Commitment to Regulatory Excellence
ministry.description: This official classification certificate from the Ministry of Municipalities and Housing validates TMYAZNA's technical, financial, and administrative capabilities as a trusted contractor within the Kingdom. It serves as formal recognition of our capacity to execute large-scale multi-disciplinary projects, including general contracting, construction, and specialized engineering services. This qualification officially empowers TMYAZNA to legally participate in major government tenders and secure commercial contracts for infrastructure and industrial developments across Saudi Arabia.

authority.title: Saudi Contractors Authority (SCA) Membership
authority.subtitle: TMYAZNA's Commitment to Industry Best Practices
authority.description: Our active registration with the Saudi Contractors Authority (SCA) solidifies TMYAZNA's position as a fully vetted, transparent, and legally compliant organization within the Saudi construction sector. By adhering to the SCA's strict professional regulations, we align our workforce training, safety standards, and project execution methodologies with international benchmarks. This membership reinforces our status as a qualified, strategic partner ready to collaborate on landmark giga-projects driving Saudi Vision 2030.
